fixtures.name: unsorted-distinct
fixtures.explanation: Unsorted array with distinct elements. Pivot selects 2 (high index). 1 < 2 is swapped to front, 3 > 2 stays right, pivot placed at index 1.

fixtures.name: duplicates
fixtures.explanation: Array with duplicate values. Pivot selects 1. 1 is placed at index 0 after final swap, yielding correctly sorted [1, 2, 2].

fixtures.name: already-ordered
fixtures.explanation: Already sorted ascending array. Lomuto partition compares each element against pivot 3, placing pivot at end without swaps.

fixtures.name: reversed
fixtures.explanation: Reversed array. Worst-case partition for Lomuto high-pivot, partitioning elements one by one into [1, 2, 3].

fixtures.name: singleton
fixtures.explanation: Smallest non-trivial collection (single element). Base case low === high triggers immediately without partitioning.

fixtures.name: empty
fixtures.explanation: Smallest supported collection (empty collection). Handles boundary gracefully without recursion or errors.
